title: Scanner Techs
caption: Scanner Techs (V)
lore: Specialized scanner technicians examine scanner output to identify the presence of life forms. Experienced operators can even identify species and gender.
game_text: Deploy on table. During opponent’s move phase, may use 3 Force to peek at opponent’s hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner’s Used Pile. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not place those cards in Used Pile. {alter}
